# Repository Skills Index

This directory collects links to per-action `skills.md` files so agents and maintainers can quickly find developer notes and action-specific guidance.

Available action skills:

- WinCC OA Ctrl Test Framework Runner: [actions/winccoa-ctrl-test-framework-runner/skills.md](actions/winccoa-ctrl-test-framework-runner/skills.md)
- (Add more actions here as `actions/<action>/skills.md`)

How to use:

- Add or update `skills.md` inside the related `actions/<action>/` directory.
- Add an entry to this index pointing to the action `skills.md` file above.
